checks.command:
bash -lc set -e
ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
DIR="$ROOT/.omx/state/paper-perfection-successor-2026-07-29/experiment-reports/PPCC2-E006"
cd "$DIR"
tmp=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ppcc2-e006-tools.XXXXXX")
trap 'trash "$tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
go build -o "$tmp/widthcheck" "$ROOT/internal/pdrender/cmd/widthcheck"
go build -o "$tmp/htmlcheck" "$ROOT/internal/pdrender/cmd/htmlcheck"
for fixture in artifacts/fixtures/*; do
  w80=$($tmp/widthcheck "$fixture/tui80.txt" 80)
  w40=$($tmp/widthcheck "$fixture/tui40.txt" 40)
  gui=$($tmp/htmlcheck gui "$fixture/studio.html")
  email=$($tmp/htmlcheck email "$fixture/email.html")
  jq -e -n --argjson w80 "$w80" --argjson w40 "$w40" --argjson gui "$gui" --argjson email "$email" '$w80.overflow_lines==0 and $w40.overflow_lines==0 and $gui.body_found and $gui.meaningful and $email.body_found and $email.meaningful and $email.links_valid' >/dev/null
done
echo 'external widthcheck/htmlcheck: PASS (9 fixtures x 4 checks)'
